name: ais-referral-intake
description: Receives a referred AIS quote from evari-mordor (gateway trigger, called by the QUIVA_CREATE_REFERRAL_TASK collation) and materialises it in CIP_REFERRALS: decision record, task, decision form action, then the immutable submission snapshot LAST with completed:true — that write is what fires ais-referral-research. IDEMPOTENT: FIND_TASK looks for a task whose `source` is this topic_prefix and the run stops if one exists, so a replay (or the collation's non-atomic partitionKey letting two cold containers through) updates nothing rather than raising a duplicate. TWO ORDERING RULES: (1) seed the task action BEFORE setting status, because writing an action recomputes the status (workspaces-service/handler/task_actions.go:50-98); (2) create the submission LAST with completed:true — that write is what fires ais-referral-research, and it carries task_id/decision_id so research needs no lookup. EVERY ARTEFACT IS FILED UNDER ITS BUILDER: FIND_BUILDER/PICK_BUILDER/CREATE_BUILDER find or open the ais_builder record for this builder name and BUILDER_FOLDER carries its folder onto the task and onto the decision, submission and (through builder_folder on the snapshot) research records. The folder is read back from records-service, never re-derived: it is sha256(field:normalised value) and the flow sandbox has no crypto. The task's `contact` is NOT used — on the live build a create carrying identity comes back with neither a folder nor the base_record_skipped reason the handler promises, so the folder is set explicitly. Records store the relative folder, tasks the full spaces.<SPACE>.<folder> path. Record config ids stay cip_* on purpose: an id is immutable and live records hang off it.
